{{Top}}
[[File:Vibro-shiv.jpg|thumb|250px|A vibro-shiv.]]
'''Vibro-shivs''' or '''powershivs''' were small [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]]. A device within the hilt vibrated these small blades at a tremendous rate, allowing them to become far more deadly and efficient. The vibration of such weapons was so fast that even a slight touch could produce a large gash, while a slash could sever a limb. A non-vibration blade of comparable size was nowhere near as deadly.

Typical vibro-shiv weapons included knives and daggers, the most common; [[Vibroknuckler/Legends|vibroknucklers]], which were basically like knuckledusters except with a blade; and vibro-scalpels and -lancets, which were more commonly used on operating tables.

Vibro-shivs were cheap and small enough that they could be concealed easily.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
